I read `AGENTS.md`, then `docs/flows/level-up.md`, and checked `levelUp` and `XP_THRESHOLDS` in the code. I didn't open the frontend files, so the frontend line numbers come from the docs.

**When the UI offers it**
- The Worker decides. `shouldLevelUp` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) returns true when `level < 10` and `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]`.
- `XP_THRESHOLDS` (`worker/src/types/index.ts:175`) is `0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000`. Index N is the XP needed to reach level N+1, and the frontend copy is in `game.models.ts:146`.
- The Worker returns the result as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`).
- The frontend also computes a value itself in `CharacterStateService.setCharacter` → `checkLevelUp` (`character-state.service.ts:52,76`). The server's value then overwrites it (`game-console.component.ts:128,155`).
- The UI shows the offer in two places:
  - The ability picker in the console sidebar (`game-console.component.html:19-28`), shown when `charSvc.canLevelUp()` is true.
  - A banner in the character sheet (`character-sheet.component.html:66`).
- After combat, a system message also prompts the player (`game-console.component.ts:172`).

**Endpoint call**
- The player clicks an ability in the picker (`game-console.component.html:24`), which calls `levelUp(key)` (`game-console.component.ts:183`).
- That calls `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`), which sends `POST /api/levelup`.
- The handler is `levelUpRoutes.post('/')` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`).
- It requires `abilityChoice` to be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha (`:23-25`).
- It returns 400 if `shouldLevelUp` is false (`:31`).

**What changes on the character**
- `levelUp` (`services/character.ts:133`) makes these changes, then saves them with `updateCharacter` and re-reads the character:
  - `level` goes up by 1.
  - HP gain is `roll(CLASS_HIT_DICE[class]) + modifier(con)` (`:141`). The hit dice are Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8 and Wizard d6.
  - `max_hp` goes up by the HP gain, and `hp` goes up by the same amount but is capped at the new `max_hp` (`:146`).
  - The chosen ability goes up by 2 (`:151-152`).
- AC is unchanged, and ability scores are not capped at 20.
- Only one level is applied per call. A character with enough XP for two levels has to call the endpoint twice.

**Side effects and client update**
- The route calls `generateLevelUpNarrative` (`ai-dm.ts:304`). It usually returns fallback text because of bug B-03.
- It inserts an `adventure_log` row with role `system` and the text `[Level Up] <name> reached Level N! …` (`levelup.ts:39-50`). The flow doc says it also adds a DM history turn.
- The client then calls `setCharacter` with the updated character and `setCanLevelUp(false)`, and adds a system message and updates the campaign slot level (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`).
